plan.title: Split award with empty approval remark

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with two bids in Master QCS.
Enable split line-wise awarding for the tenant.
Enable eRFX projects required by the case.
Open the awarding screen for the closed event.
Allocate 6 units of the line to Vendor B.
Allocate the remaining 4 units to Vendor A.
Verify both vendors are awarded and the split total is 6 × 90 plus 4 × 100, equaling 940.
Create the award proposal from the completed split allocation.
Complete mandatory proposal fields before submission.
Verify the submitted proposal is pending approval.

args.need: sign in as the approver and approve the submitted proposal with an empty remark, confirming the refusal 'Remark is necessary for approval' and that the proposal stays pending
